text:
maria: Quick PR to refresh streaming snippets for py/ts/go. Want minimal patterns for AbortController/context and a compact retry example. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5102

kyler: LGTM. Keep Go example short and show signal.NotifyContext to avoid leaked goroutines. Add one-liner about runtime rename (retries.max_attempts) and keep a compatibility note for Go.

dev-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/branch/streaming-quick (build 4f2a) :white_check_mark:

maria: Pushed small edits: TS uses for-await + AbortController, Python shows generator + retries dict, Go shows compact NotifyContext + retry loop. Merging after CI.

kyler: Nice. Also added a tiny test snippet to examples that asserts chunk.seq is monotonic so users don't assume reordering.

maria: Merged. Closing thread. :tada:
